title: Apple Music held-error and probe state are hardened after RF-107
acceptance: The held Apple Music playback error (apple-music-adapter.ts onPlaybackError) carries an attempt token captured when the error fires and is delivered only if prepare/stop/destroy have not started a new attempt, with a test that a held error is dropped after destroy then prepare.
The probe timeout path in musickit.ts handles a late rejection of the settled promise, so no unhandledrejection can escape, with a test.

The probe's word is written in one place (one settle handler) and the module keeps one probe record instead of three globals plus a test-only generation counter; built-in error constructors are computed once.
Existing RF-107 probe and adapter tests stay green.
nextAction: Do with or just before RF-108, which reworks apple-music-adapter.ts. Owner-gated (playback code).

evidence.summary: Final review of #649 on 82bffde: non-significant findings logged 2026-10-28. The held-error staleness is not reachable today because runtime.ts builds a fresh adapter per track and drops stale onError by epoch and adapter identity; the attempt token is defense in depth.
